pages.title: Streak Penalty
pages.text: Eating the same food back to back does not just trigger diminishing returns — it triggers them $(bold)twice as fast$().$(br2)Eat the same item within $(bold)5 minutes$() of the last time you ate it and the eat count buildup doubles. Your $(thing)Diversity score$() will drop visibly faster than if you had spaced those meals out.

pages.title: Breaking the Streak
pages.text: Eat $(italic)something else$() in between. That is it.$(br2)You do not need to wait out the full memory window — just break the consecutive run. Even one different food resets the streak.$(br2)The $(thing)Last eaten$() line on food tooltips tells you exactly how long ago you had that food.$(br2)$(italic)If it says zero meals ago — eat something else first.$()
